subject: Scene.getElement
prompt: Outside tests, which functions or methods call the getElement() method of the Scene class (packages/element/src/Scene.ts)? Count only calls on a Scene instance (for example scene.getElement, this.scene.getElement, app.scene.getElement, with or without a type argument), not LinearElementEditor.getElement, the getElement of the element store in transform.ts, or other getElement functions. Name class methods as Class.method, module-level functions and React components by their bare name, and code inside a registered action object (export const actionX = register({...})) by the action's constant name. Calls inside nested callbacks count for the enclosing named function or method.
